newsitem.title: USA: NY substation fire downs six transmission lines.
newsitem.headline: NY substation fire downs six transmission lines.

text.p: A fire Wednesday at a Consolidated Edison Co of New York substation near Yonkers, N.Y., shut down six high-voltage transmission lines, the New York Power Pool (NYPP) said.
"It has lead to some (line) outages...We had a number of transmission lines out," said a NYPP spokesman, adding the fire was still burning at 0955 EST.
The pool recorded four 345 kilovolt (KV) and 138 KV transmission lines were taken out of service by automatic safety mechanisms when the fire broke out at the Sprainbrook substation.
"Transmission lines were disconnected. The relay equipments sensed a drop in voltage," the spokesman said.
ConEd blamed the substation fire for a major power dip earlier today in New York City.
